info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Retail Orders Tracks-v1-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Tracking API allows users to retrieve the current status of retail orders. It provides an accessible way to track orders throughout their fulfillment journey, ensuring consumers can stay informed about their purchases. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and customer service applications. This functionality helps improve customer experience by providing transparency and timely updates regarding order statuses.

get.summary: Track the status of an order
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current tracking information of their orders, including delivery status and estimated arrival times.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking an order. This should contain the order identifier needed to retrieve the current tracking status of the order.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation related to tracking orders.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.title: Order Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the order.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the tracking request in milliseconds.

message.description: Error or status message related to the tracking operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the tracking operation.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for tracking an order.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Name or identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information about the creator and creation time of the order tracking audit.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value indicates a faster response.
